scope: Failure recovery of the isolated-Caldera Docker lifecycle. This protocol does not establish CTI fidelity, historical adversary equivalence, QEMU behavior, Windows behavior, or multi-host behavior.

cells.property: Lifecycle signal recovery after a real SUT container exists.
External process-group termination and verified namespace cleanup after partial SUT setup.
Recovery while a real readiness probe is in flight against isolated infrastructure.
Cleanup after Sandcat launch and an observed Caldera enrollment poll with no matching agent yet registered.
Lifecycle signal recovery after Caldera returned a real operation identifier.
External termination and cleanup while Caldera reports a real operation as running.
Recovery while the independent effect probe has begun.
External recovery after execution state exists and immediately before persistence.
Lifecycle signal recovery after the attacker resource is present and teardown has begun.
External recovery after the SUT resource is present and teardown has begun.

qualification_rule: Every predeclared cell must be recorded after the protocol is frozen, on one immutable clean implementation revision. Each bundle must contain an observed target condition, a sealed child manifest, a matching independent supervisor receipt, the expected injection evidence, a completed cleanup inventory, and no run-owned residual resources. A boundary_not_observed, incomplete, dirty, incompatible, or excluded attempt remains accounted for and prevents qualification.
